/* selectSplymtEnblrDtlListCount - BaekGyuHa */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT FROM ( SELECT F.INST_NO /* 쉼터번호 */ , F.INST_NM /* 쉼터명 */ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'FCLTY_TYPE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = I.FCLTY_TYPE_SE_CD) AS FCLTY_TYPE_NM /* 쉼터유형 */ , B.CASE_BGNG_YMD /* 입소일자 */ , B.CASE_TRMN_YMD /* 퇴소일자 */ , NVL(TO_DATE(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD) - TO_DATE(B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) + 1,0) AS IN_DAY /* 입소기간 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(L.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_NM /* 담당자 */ , L.WRD_TELNO /* 담당자연락처 */ FROM SEB100 B /* 사례기본 테이블 */ LEFT JOIN SEB150 C /* 사례담당자 */ ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND C.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' /* 주담당자여부 */ INNER JOIN SAA000 F /* 통합기관 - 쉼터명을 가지기 위한 번호 */ ON C.PIC_INST_NO = F.INST_NO LEFT JOIN AKA500 I /* 센터현황 */ ON C.PIC_INST_NO = I.INST_NO LEFT JOIN AEA100 K /* 쉼터사례정보 only 입소*/ ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = K.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = K.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SCA100 L /* 쉼터사례정보 only 입소*/ ON C.CASE_PIC_NO = L.ENFSN_NO WHERE B.TRPR_INFO_NO IN ( SELECT TRPR_INFO_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND INDV_IDNTFC_NO IN ( SELECT INDV_IDNTFC_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} ) UNION SELECT TRPR_INFO_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} ) AND B.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD IN ('04', '06', '07', '08', '09', '10', '11') /* 종결,사후관리,사례(사후)관리종결,재가입 (07/09/11-코드없음) */ AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND K.SHELTR_TRPR_SE_CD = '1' /* 입소*/ ORDER BY B.CASE_BGNG_YMD )

SELECT Z.* FROM ( /* selectSplymtEnblrDtlList (청소년안전망시스템 입소 내역) - BaekGyuHa */ SELECT F.INST_NO /* 쉼터번호 */ , F.INST_NM /* 쉼터명 */ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'FCLTY_TYPE_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = I.FCLTY_TYPE_SE_CD) AS FCLTY_TYPE_NM /* 쉼터유형 */ , B.CASE_BGNG_YMD /* 입소일자 */ , B.CASE_TRMN_YMD /* 퇴소일자 */ , NVL(TO_DATE(B.CASE_TRMN_YMD) - TO_DATE(B.CASE_BGNG_YMD) + 1,0) AS IN_DAY /* 입소기간 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(L.FLNM_ENCPT) AS FLNM_NM /* 담당자 */ , L.WRD_TELNO /* 담당자연락처 */ FROM SEB100 B /* 사례기본 테이블 */ LEFT JOIN SEB150 C /* 사례담당자 */ ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND C.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' /* 주담당자여부 */ INNER JOIN SAA000 F /* 통합기관 - 쉼터명을 가지기 위한 번호 */ ON C.PIC_INST_NO = F.INST_NO LEFT JOIN AKA500 I /* 센터현황 */ ON C.PIC_INST_NO = I.INST_NO LEFT JOIN AEA100 K /* 쉼터사례정보 only 입소*/ ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = K.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = K.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SCA100 L /* 쉼터사례정보 only 입소*/ ON C.CASE_PIC_NO = L.ENFSN_NO WHERE B.TRPR_INFO_NO IN ( SELECT TRPR_INFO_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND INDV_IDNTFC_NO IN ( SELECT INDV_IDNTFC_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} ) UNION SELECT TRPR_INFO_NO FROM SEA200 WHERE TRPR_INFO_NO = #{TRPR_INFO_NO} ) AND B.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD IN ('04', '06', '07', '08', '09', '10', '11') /* 종결,사후관리,사례(사후)관리종결,재가입 (07/09/11-코드없음) */ AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND K.SHELTR_TRPR_SE_CD = '1' /* 입소*/ ORDER BY B.CASE_BGNG_YMD )Z

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT FROM ( /* selectSplymtEnblrDtlSEB900ListCount (구 시스템 입소 내역) - BaekGyuHa */ SELECT DSCSN_INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 쉼터명 */ , INST_KND_NM AS FCLTY_TYPE_NM /* 쉼터유형 */ , CASE_BGNG_YMD /* 입소일자 */ , CASE_END_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD /* 퇴소일자 */ , NVL(TO_DATE(CASE_END_YMD) - TO_DATE(CASE_BGNG_YMD) + 1,0) AS IN_DAY /* 입소기간 */ , ETC_TELNO , ETC_TELNO1 , ETC_TELNO2 , PARNTS_TELNO , EML_ADDR_ENCPT FROM SEB900 /* 원스크린 */ WHERE TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND FLNM_ENCPT = #{TRPR_NM} AND BRTH_YMD = #{BRTH_YMD} AND SXDC_SE_CD = #{SXDC_SE_CD}
